notes.title: v2.10.0
notes.content:
- Support the Modifier feature.
- Fix bug.

notes.title: NEW Function Added!!
notes.content:
■ VR Camera Function
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30768274/24cad20562c5361297b61338c1b5f86c58fe44d7.png[/img]

A camera function has also been  implemented, which now allows users to take photos from within their VR scene and then within seconds share those photos online by posting them to the Gallery.

The photos taken from within VR are automatically saved in the STYLY VR VIEWER (https://suite.styly.cc/download/) under the ‘My Photos’ tab. You can then select which photos they want to post to the gallery site.

You can also share the photos on Twitter or Facebook with a simple click from the STYLY Gallery page (http://gallery.styly.cc/).

Let’s become VR photographers, and share our pictures with the world.


■ WebView is ready 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30768274/b016e0f0f418c90342b741e429990ea9191dabb0.png[/img]

To allow people who do not have a VR headset to also enjoy VR content, WebView audiovisual is now available. You can view scenes in WebView by clicking on the cube icon in the bottom-right corner of each page on STYLY Gallery.


■ About other New Functions
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30768274/9fce5a363646dd38a75b373e3986c5c4193db497.png[/img]

1. Assets are now available to input the numeric value for enlarge / rotation / movement. 
It only had the function to move assets using mouse, before the update.

2. Asset lists are optimized.
The followings are now available on the asset list in the left corner of editing page.

・Sort by Drag＆Drop
・Change name of the assets
・Converse show/hide function just by clicking the thumbnail
・Change title in the scene list
